name: Shop Inventory Management System
description: Developed an inventory management system for our local village store to streamline the delivery acceptance process. The system enables staff to quickly search for products, verify incoming deliveries, and update inventory, replacing the previous manual paper-based workflow and significantly reducing the time required to process shipments.
bulletPoints: User-Interface with HTML, CSS and JS connected to a Python backend.
Automatically extracts product information from supplier delivery PDFs and converts it into structured JSON data.
Implemented a fast search system that allows staff to instantly locate products when validating deliveries, replacing the previous paper-list process and greatly reducing manual work.
